entries.category_description: Supply of services by undertakers and cremation services, and the supply of goods related thereto
entries.comment:
The services normally supplied by undertakers - Royal Decree N° 20, Table A, category XXXIV, 2° with the exception - of food and drinks for immediate consumption 
- the services supplied by waiters, servants and other persons intervening in the supply of food and drinks to consumers under conditions permitting consumption on the spot, 
- the services relating to the supply of crypts or tombs

The reduced rate only applies for 96.03 in that context
